Key_observation: Global structure is primarily associated with cell type rather than sample. Strong sample-specific separation is mainly observed within hepatocytes.
Reason_no_global_integration: Sample, patient and anatomical site are partially confounded. Global correction by sample could remove genuine patient-, tumor-, PVTT- or metastasis-associated biology. Therefore unintegrated representation is retained for primary major-cell annotation.
Hepatocyte_policy: Reassess batch/patient/site effects after hepatocyte/malignant-cell extraction. Any later correction will be performed locally and evaluated against biological preservation.
Optional_sensitivity_analysis: Integrated representations may be generated later as sensitivity analyses but will not replace the primary unintegrated representation without evidence.
